answer: A farm of 242 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are logged in ember, queued in karst, and cipher publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 63 identities per epoch. A farm of 701 identities would post 1954 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
